result_text:
A sub-landscape with a missing or unreadable `config.json` no longer aborts the parent landscape report. The module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't try a report with a missing config, so the fix itself is unchecked.

The change is in `addSubLandscapeRow` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportSubLandscapesSection.java`. `getSubLandscapeConfig` already returned `null` when the file was missing or unreadable, and the row code then dereferenced it. It now treats a `null` config as having no logo, so the row falls back to the default landscape logo. It still renders the link to the index page and the other cells. Sub-landscapes that do have a config keep their own logo.

One thing I left alone: as before, only top-level rows (labels without a `/`) get a logo cell. Nested sub-landscapes get an empty one, whether or not their config exists.
